guideline: Map.addControl takes a position of top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right; the default is top-right.
keywords: control position; addControl; corner; top-left; top-right; bottom-left; bottom-right
do: Pass an explicit position to addControl so control placement is deliberate.
dont: Rely on the top-right default when several controls compete for that corner.

guideline: Some controls choose their own default position: AttributionControl bottom-right, ScaleControl bottom-left, LogoControl bottom-left.
keywords: default position; attribution control; scale control; logo control; getDefaultPosition; overlap
do: Check the built-in positions before placing custom widgets, to avoid overlapping attribution, scale or logo.
dont: Put custom UI in the bottom corners without accounting for attribution, scale and logo.

guideline: The attributionControl map option takes false or AttributionControlOptions. Showing the MapLibre logo is not required.
keywords: attributionControl option; hide attribution; maplibre logo; MapOptions; customAttribution
do: Configure attribution through the attributionControl option and keep the data-source credit visible.
dont: Set attributionControl to false and drop the credit entirely.
code_bad: new maplibregl.Map({container:'map', attributionControl:false}); // no credit anywhere

guideline: Mapbox data requires both the Mapbox logo and the text attribution. The logo may be moved to another corner but not restyled; text colour and size may be adjusted if still legible.
keywords: mapbox logo; text attribution; wordmark; legible; attribution requirement; license
do: Keep the Mapbox logo and the text attribution both visible; move the logo only between corners.
dont: Hide, recolour or restyle the Mapbox logo, or make the attribution text illegible.

guideline: Leaflet and OpenLayers do not add the Mapbox logo or attribution when you use Mapbox data, so add them yourself.
keywords: mapbox in leaflet; mapbox in openlayers; add attribution manually; logo
do: When consuming Mapbox tiles or styles through another library, add the Mapbox logo and attribution text manually.
dont: Assume the host library renders the Mapbox logo and attribution for you.

guideline: To move attribution, set attributionControl to false and add an AttributionControl at the chosen position.
keywords: move attribution; attribution position; AttributionControl; addControl; top-left
do: Disable the default control, then add your own AttributionControl at the position you want.
dont: Add a second AttributionControl without disabling the default one.

guideline: Feature-state hover: use a paint expression ['boolean', ['feature-state','hover'], false] and call setFeatureState on mousemove, resetting the previous id and on mouseleave.
keywords: hover; feature-state; setFeatureState; highlight; mousemove; mouseleave; hover style
do: Drive hover styling with feature-state, and reset the previous feature on mousemove and all state on mouseleave.
dont: Leave the previous feature highlighted, or rebuild source data on every mousemove.

guideline: The feature-state expression is not supported in layer filter expressions.
keywords: feature-state filter; filter expression; unsupported; style spec
do: Use feature-state only in paint and layout expressions; filter on feature properties instead.
dont: Use ['feature-state', ...] inside a layer filter.

guideline: GeoJSON clustering: set cluster true on the source; clusterRadius defaults to 50, clusterMaxZoom to maxzoom-1, clusterMinPoints to 2. Clusters carry cluster, cluster_id, point_count and point_count_abbreviated.
keywords: cluster; clustering; cluster points; clusterRadius; clusterMaxZoom; clusterMinPoints; point_count; dense points
do: Enable source clustering for dense point data and style clusters using point_count.
dont: Draw tens of thousands of overlapping point markers unclustered.

guideline: GeoJSON source defaults: maxzoom 18, buffer 128 (range 0-512), tolerance 0.375.
keywords: geojson source; maxzoom; buffer; tolerance; simplification; defaults
do: Tune maxzoom, buffer and tolerance on GeoJSON sources deliberately for large or detailed data.
dont: Leave defaults unchecked on heavy sources, or set buffer outside 0-512.

guideline: For large GeoJSON, set source maxzoom below 18 (12 suggested for most point data), remove unused properties, use at most 6-decimal coordinates and cluster at low zoom. Beyond about 500,000 points use further techniques.
keywords: large geojson; slow; maxzoom; coordinate precision; remove properties; 500000 points; vector tiles
do: Lower the source maxzoom, strip unused properties, round coordinates to 6 decimals and cluster at low zoom.
dont: Ship full-precision GeoJSON with every property to the browser.

guideline: Layer minzoom and maxzoom range 0-24. The layer is hidden below minzoom and at or above maxzoom.
keywords: minzoom; maxzoom; zoom range; layer visibility; scale dependent
do: Use minzoom and maxzoom to show detailed layers only at suitable zooms.
dont: Assume maxzoom is inclusive; the layer is hidden at maxzoom.

guideline: addLayer(layer, beforeId) and moveLayer(id, beforeId) insert beneath beforeId; without it the layer goes on top of all others.
keywords: layer order; beforeId; addLayer; moveLayer; z-order; labels above
do: Pass beforeId to place data layers under basemap labels.
dont: Add every layer on top and cover basemap labels.

guideline: raster-opacity is a paint property with range 0-1, default 1; it supports interpolate expressions and is transitionable.
keywords: raster opacity; raster-opacity; transparency; overlay; fade; transition
do: Expose a 0-1 opacity control driving raster-opacity for imagery overlays.
dont: Use a fully opaque raster overlay with no way to see the basemap beneath.

guideline: flyTo and easeTo run instantly when the OS reduced-motion setting is on, unless essential is true.
keywords: reduced motion; prefers-reduced-motion; flyTo; easeTo; essential; animation; accessibility
do: Leave essential unset so users with reduced-motion preferences get instant moves.
dont: Set essential:true on decorative camera animations.
code_bad: map.flyTo({center, zoom:10, essential:true}); // ignores reduced motion

guideline: FlyToOptions: curve defaults to 1.42 (the average from a user study), speed to 1.2; also maxDuration, minZoom and screenSpeed.
keywords: flyTo options; curve; speed; maxDuration; minZoom; screenSpeed; camera animation
do: Cap long flights with maxDuration or tune speed and curve rather than hard-coding long durations.
dont: Animate across continents with an unbounded flight time.

guideline: The map event map includes error (ErrorEvent), so register map.on('error', ...) for per-source or per-tile failures.
keywords: error event; map.on error; tile failure; source error; error state; retry
do: Listen for the error event and surface a per-layer or per-source error state.
dont: Let tile and source failures pass silently.

guideline: GeolocateControl: trackUserLocation false (default) is a one-shot button; true makes a toggle with active, passive and disabled states (disabled = unavailable or denied).
keywords: geolocate; geolocation; trackUserLocation; locate me; permission denied; states
do: Choose trackUserLocation deliberately and design for the disabled state when permission is denied or unavailable.
dont: Assume geolocation always works; hide the denied state.

guideline: ScaleControl takes maxWidth (example 80) and unit 'imperial' or 'metric'; change it later with setUnit().
keywords: scale bar; ScaleControl; maxWidth; unit; metric; imperial; setUnit
do: Match the scale unit to the audience and offer setUnit for a toggle.
dont: Hard-code one unit for an international audience.
code_good: const s = new maplibregl.ScaleControl({maxWidth:80, unit:'metric'}); map.addControl(s); s.setUnit('imperial');

guideline: The map option keyboard (default true) enables keyboard shortcuts.
keywords: keyboard; keyboard shortcuts; keyboard navigation; map option; accessibility
do: Keep keyboard enabled so the map is operable without a mouse.
dont: Disable the keyboard option on an interactive map.
